name: Launchpad
description: Three jobs you hand to an agent often, one press each; you read each message before it is sent.

options.label: First job
options.default: Review my uncommitted changes: say what is wrong or risky, file by file.

options.label: Second job
options.default: Run the tests. Fix what fails, and tell me what you changed.

options.label: Third job
options.default: Write the changelog entry for the work since the last release.

commands.name: jobs
commands.description: The three jobs its buttons start, with their labels.
